scope: Every image file tracked in this repository. An asset that is not listed here is not cleared for publication.
policy: No upstream image, icon set, clip-art, texture, font file, or application screenshot is redistributed here. A permissive license on a surrounding repository is not a rights record for an image taken from it.
Each asset below is original vector work authored for this repository and is covered by the repository LICENSE (MIT).
Illustrations and renders are made for this repository. None of them is a screenshot of the Obsidian application, and none of them is evidence that anything rendered in a running app.
"Obsidian" names the third-party application these skills target. No vendor logo, product icon, or UI asset is included, and no affiliation or endorsement is claimed.

Raster renders are produced by scripts/art/library.py in Blender (Cycles) from primitives, procedural textures and procedural materials only: no HDRI, image texture, scanned model or downloaded asset is used. Typography in the composites is set in the operating system's fonts at export time; no font file is redistributed.

assets.depicts: A moonlit stone terrace at night: from a reading desk with a candle lantern, open books with fanned, printed pages and loose leaves fly out over the balustrade toward the moon, under the Milky Way and constellations drawn between bright stars, above layered mountain ridges. Fine lines of light link the books, the loose pages and the open book on the desk into one network that runs on into a constellation, so the flock itself reads as a constellation. Wordmark, tagline and a render credit are set at the top left and bottom right.
